text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy isn't feeling well, so I<n>take her to the
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Only a quick break, understand?! I<n>just gotta lie
down for a bit, and then<n>I'll be ready to run again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where am I?

Stop right there, Windy! Windy! This is<n>the end of
the line!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What the heck's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm here to put an end to your evil<n>plans for world
domination!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The time has come to settle things!<n>Brace yourself!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I see what's goin' on here...<n>And in that
case!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: MWAHAHAHA! You'll never defeat<n>Wicked Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
After I deal with the two of you, the<n>world will be
mine for the takin'!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Tch!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: How did we let the world fall into her<n>clutches?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! You'd need to train for<n>another
hundred years to even think<n>of defeatin' me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So I'll throw you two a bone and hold<n>off on my
world domination until then!

text_block_list.name: Biko and Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Eh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
In one hundred years, once you've<n>grown stronger,
I'll wipe the floor<n>with you again! Wicked Windy
has<n>spoken!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So scram and start training! Come<n>back and
challenge me when you're<n>actually ready!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: MWAHAHAHA! What an awesome<n>dream!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm the most powerful being in the<n>world!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not entirely sure what happened,<n>but Shinko
Windy appears to have<n>recovered.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Now, come at me with all you've g—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bing-bong!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang-bong!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Wait... What about my world<n>domination?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And I was just getting to the best<n>part!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy's condition remains<n>poor after her
pleasant dream is<n>abruptly interrupted.
